title: Nash Existence In Convex Games
body_html:
Nash Existence In Convex Games

Every convex game in the sense of MFoGT Exercise 4.12.7 has a Nash equilibrium.

The exercise proves this by contradiction: if no $t$ satisfies the variational characterization, a finite open cover and a partition-of-unity construction produce a continuous self-map of the compact convex strategy space. Brouwer's theorem gives a fixed point, contradicting the construction.
